lines.t: Those who are fully awake, who having received the knowledge and love of the truth,
knowing the Messiah fulfills all in every sense, in all manner.
Every word written, every word spoken,
Being altogether the all in all of all things
Cause in all, both great and small
Rich and poor, bond and free
For this truth is an emblazoned, torture-waving banner
And it's seen to all generations beyond all question
For He is who He is
For He is who He is
And there is none like Him
Yahushua, Yahushua, Yahushua, Yahushua, Yahushua, Yahushua
Yahushua HaMashiach, the Holy One of Israel
